description:
## Bug Fixes

### YouTube
- **Feed card layout, video previews:** A video that plays inside a card in the feed is visible again. The card colour was painted over the video, so you saw only a flat colour with the mute and CC buttons on it. The card keeps its dynamic colour under the title and channel row.
- **Feed card layout, Shorts shelf:** The autoplaying Short in the Shorts shelf no longer shows as an empty dark box.
- **Feed card layout, action icons:** The like, comment and save icons keep their colour. A dark tint from another card could stay on an icon when the app reused its view.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.29.0...v1.29.1)
